title: Reading a nonempty state window
statement: For all natural numbers $j$ and $n$, the state window with $j$ consumed symbols and $n+1$ remaining symbols contains $1$ at cell $j+1$.
replaced:
In a state window with $j$ erased cells and $n + 1$ remaining unary cells,
the cell at position $j + 1$ (the current lookup position) holds the bit $1$.
